description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This vital leadership role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. If you are an RN with a passion for leadership and clinical oversight, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. This position is ideal for a proactive leader who thrives in a dynamic healthcare setting and is committed to fostering a positive and effective care team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent clinical assessment and communication skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, with a salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year.

description:
We are seeking an accomplished VP of Clinical to oversee clinical operations across multiple health and rehabilitation centers in the OKC and Tulsa, OK regions. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to drive clinical excellence, ensure high-quality patient care, and implement best practices across a network of facilities.

This is an urgent and high-priority search for a top-tier candidate. We offer a highly competitive compensation package, including a significant bonus potential, and are prepared to offer more for the right individual who can bring exceptional leadership and expertise to our organization.
requirements: Current clinical licensure (e.g., Registered Nurse) in Oklahoma
Extensive experience in clinical leadership and management roles
Proven track record of overseeing clinical operations across multiple facilities
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance, and quality improvement initiatives
Demonstrated ability to drive positive clinical outcomes and foster a culture of excellence
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $120,000 to $140,000 annually, with additional bonus potential. We are prepared to offer more for the ideal candidate.
